title.tr: Toprak zeminde taş döşemeli çaprazlı merdiven
title.en: Cross-braced stairs on soil with stone slabs at the foot

alt.tr: İlk basamağın önüne taş döşenmiş çaprazlı korkuluklu ahşap merdiven; yanda tel çit ve duvar
alt.en: Timber stairs with a cross-braced railing and flat stones laid in front of the first step

caption.tr: Merdivenin önünde toprak üzerine yassı taşlar konmuş. Korkuluk çaprazlı, yanda tel çit var.
caption.en: Flat stones are laid on the soil in front of the stairs. The railing is cross-braced and wire fencing runs alongside.
